items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Another fellow I know that Professor Tuck, he went great for a good while and a number of years.

ctx.x: That was a big band around here too, one of those big officers they had around here. A fellow by the name of MacNeil, I think was the leader of that band, he's a trumpet player. MacNeil. Yeah. I don't know his first name, but I know or remember MacNeil. I remember when he was taking lessons from the old fellow by the name of Shala Neal, he was a professor. Shala Neal standing right around the corner from my house and I used to go around there and play with his grandson and I was always friends. We went to school…
Yeah, he's still alive up in New York. Up near New York City.
